card.name: Immune reconstitution warning wording
card.fires_on: The word "develop" in the HIV label sentence "patients whose immune system responds may develop an inflammatory response to indolent or residual" infections. It sometimes fires on the next word "an".

modes.label: Verb in immune reconstitution sentence
modes.description: "develop" right after "may" in the standard antiretroviral warning about inflammatory response.
modes.example: During the initial phase of combination antiretroviral treatment, patients whose immune systems respond may<< develop>> an inflammatory response to indolent or

card.plain: It marks the stock label sentence saying that patients starting HIV treatment may develop an inflammatory response to hidden infections.
